title: Read Scan
text: Extract scan data from ROS or ROS 2 laser scan message, 1 input, 4 outputs; {Maximum array length} sets the maximum length of the laser scan array, {Show Angles output port} sets the rGB port toggle, {Show Intensity output port} sets the intensity port toggle, {Show ErrorCode output port} sets the errorCode port toggle and {Output variable-size signals} sets the variable-size signal output toggle. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Msg
ports.summary: ROS or ROS 2 laser scan message nonvirtual bus

ports.name: Ranges
ports.summary: Range values for each point array

ports.name: Angles
ports.summary: Angle values for each point array

ports.name: Intensities
ports.summary: Intensity value for each point array

ports.name: ErrorCode
ports.summary: Error code for message parsing scalar

params.name: Maximum array length
params.values: Maximum length of the laser scan array 100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output variable-size signals
params.values: Variable-size signal output toggle off (default) | on
